subheadline: Stay in the Middle of it All.
long-description: The Lodge rooms sit directly above the restaurant, bar and fireside gathering spaces—the right choice for guests who want the Cowboy close at hand. Book one room or take over the floor with your people. Either way, you're never far from dinner, drinks or the fire.
name: The Lodge

subheadline: The View Does Most of the Talking.
long-description: Perched on Panther Mountain, Mountain View Haus looks across the valley toward the Big Indian Wilderness. Inside, wood beams, a river-stone hearth and a full kitchen give you the familiar pleasure of a proper mountain house. Book two bedrooms or take all four. Then put something on the fire, pour a drink and let the week loosen its grip.
feature-benefits: Available as 2 or 4 bedrooms · Sleeps up to 8
name: Mountain View Haus

subheadline: The Easygoing way Into the Catskills.
long-description: Set at the trailhead beneath Slide Mountain, these are some of our simplest rooms and our easiest way into Cowboy. Less fuss, fewer frills, and a little more room in the budget for whatever happens next. The trails start outside. Ralph’s is across the street. The rest of Cowboy is just up the hill.
name: Slide Mountain Haus

long-description: Forest House is the quieter side of the Cowboy. Tucked among the pines, these rooms carry more of the old Catskills spirit: warm, familiar and a little nostalgic, with just enough space to settle in without overthinking it. Downstairs, the Day Room and porch are there when you're ready for company.
name: Forest House

long-description: Step inside a century-old cabin built for long weekends and people you actually like traveling with. Wood beams, a river-stone hearth and a vaulted living room set the pace downstairs. Four bedrooms give everyone somewhere to disappear upstairs. Cook together. Don't cook at all. Walk the trails. Sit by the fire. There isn't much of a schedule here unless you bring one with you.
feature-benefits: Sleeps up to 8 · Available as 2 or 4 bedrooms
name: Opa's Cabin

short-description: Our largest standalone suite leans into the property's Alpine past with wood-paneled cathedral ceilings, big picture windows and a private deck overlooking the landscape. Inside, there's a full kitchen, breakfast nook, fireplace and enough living space to spread out. Outside, a cedar soaking tub for two. Come for a weekend. Pretend it's yours.
long-description: Set apart along the forest edge, The Chalet is Cowboy's largest standalone one-bedroom suite and the closest thing to borrowing your own Alpine mountain house for the weekend. Wood-paneled cathedral ceilings and big picture windows open onto two living areas, a gas fireplace, full kitchen and breakfast nook. The king bedroom is joined by a pull-out sofa, so the space can sleep up to four, while the private deck holds an outdoor cedar soaking tub for two. Private parking keeps the arrival and stay a little more self-contained. Expect real privacy, room to cook and spread out, and a stay that feels more residential than a hotel room.
name: Chalet

subheadline: Quite Literally, Your Cabin in the Woods.
short-description: Six hundred square feet. Your own porch. A copper clawfoot tub. A fireplace. Enough space to settle in and briefly consider never going home. The open-plan interior gives you a king bed, rain shower, leather loveseat and dining table, while the porch puts the Catskills just outside your door. Coffee works out there. Cocktails work better.
long-description: Completely detached along the forest edge, The Cabin is a 600-square-foot private hideaway with no shared hallway and plenty of room to settle in. The open-plan layout includes a king bed, copper clawfoot soaking tub, walk-in rain shower, gas fireplace, leather loveseat, dining or work table and private covered porch. A twin bunk or lounging nook adds flexibility, while Wright, Pendleton, Printsburgh and the minibar bring the familiar Cowboy details. Despite the standalone setting, the Lodge, sauna, trails, firepits and creekside gathering spaces are still within easy reach. Expect more privacy than a guest room, less space than a full chalet, and the feeling of having a little Catskills cabin to yourselves.
name: The Cabin

short-description: Walden sits closer to the woods. Its ten cabin-style rooms trade Alpine's lodge-like romance for something quieter and more elemental: private decks, forest views and, in the bathing suites, cedar tubs made for soaking outside.
long-description: Walden sits closer to the woods. Its ten cabin-style rooms trade Alpine's lodge-like romance for something quieter and more elemental: private decks, forest views and, in the bathing suites, cedar tubs made for soaking outside. This is where the Cowboy gets a little wilder.
feature-benefits: This is where the Cowboy gets a little wilder.
name: Haus

short-description: Built into the hillside above the Lodge, Alpine is home to ten of the Cowboy's most iconic rooms. Every suite puts a freestanding clawfoot tub in front of a picture window, with the forest and mountains doing the decorating outside.
long-description: Built into the hillside above the Lodge, Alpine is home to ten of the Cowboy's most iconic rooms. Every suite puts a freestanding clawfoot tub in front of a picture window, with the forest and mountains doing the decorating outside. This is where you come to soak, slow down and disappear for a while.
feature-benefits: This is where you come to soak, slow down and disappear for a while.
name: Alpine
